name: Multivitamin and mineral supplements
short: COSMOS found no safety concerns or change in all-cause mortality with a daily multivitamin; Physicians' Health Study II found no change in cancer deaths.
text: A systematic review for a US National Institutes of Health conference, covering randomised trials and case reports, found no consistent adverse effects of multivitamin and mineral supplements. In the COSMOS trial of 21,442 older US adults followed for a median of 3.6 years, a daily multivitamin did not significantly affect all-cause mortality and there were no safety concerns. In the Physicians' Health Study II of male US physicians aged 50 or older followed for a median of 11.2 years, a daily multivitamin modestly reduced total cancer and did not significantly change cancer mortality. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
